lines.cw1: A language model can only read a fixed number of tokens at once. That is its context window.
lines.cw2: Your prompt, the chat history, and even its own reply all have to fit inside it.
lines.cw3: When a conversation grows longer, the oldest tokens fall out of the window.
lines.cw4: The model has no memory outside it, so it can forget what you said earlier.
lines.cw5: Attention compares every token with every other, so longer windows cost far more compute.
lines.cw6: Tricks like summarising the history, or retrieving only what matters, keep the important parts in view.
lines.outro: The context window is the model's working memory. Choose carefully what goes in.
